Accommodation options in Hanoi are concentrated in three areas: Hoan Kiem, Ba Dinh, and West Lake.Hoan Kiem County gathers the most hotels and scenic spots, suitable for those who visit Hanoi for the first time; West Lake County has the largest West Lake in Hanoi and gathers many classic five-star hotels; Ba Dinh County is the political center of Vietnam, with many government agencies and foreign embassies. Modern and wide roads, with many emerging star accommodation. ・Hoan Kiem County: Named after the Hoan Kiem Lake in the territory, the commercial area in the center of Hanoi, the Thirty-six Ancient Street area north of Hoan Kiem Lake, is a backpacker base camp, and the area south of Hoan Kiem Lake is mostly schools and public education institutions With a star hotel, it is convenient to visit the main attractions in Hanoi city｜ Accommodation recommendations｜Hoan Kiem District star hotels ・Xihu County: West Lake has the largest lake in Vietnam. In the early days, it was the gathering place of five-star hotels in Hanoi. It has many riverside landscape hotels. In recent years, luxury-level serviced apartments have begun to appear, becoming the best choice for families｜ Accommodation recommendations｜Xihu County star hotels What are the latest accommodation options in Hanoi? Hanoi's newly opened star hotels have Capella Hanoi , SOJO Hotel , La Passion Hanoi Hotel , Romantique Hotel and other options, detailed introduction can refer to Hanoi Hotel Reservation Guide . What are the affordable accommodation options in downtown Hanoi? Thirty-six Ancient Street on the north side of Hoan Kiem Lake is the backpacker's base camp in Hanoi. It offers many cheap accommodation options. It gathers many youth hostels and travel agencies. You can enjoy many scenic spots in Hanoi city on foot. It is also very convenient to purchase a package tour. .
